Lead profile: SMB e-commerce SaaS (marketplace tools) exploring adding chat support + doc search to merchant-facing dashboard. Interested in self-serve Hosted API (fast time-to-value) rather than Dedicated/Private at this stage. Key asks from discovery call:

- Model selection: wants guidance on Llama vs Mistral vs Qwen family. Specifically asks about tradeoffs between 13B Llama-style models, Mistral Instruct variants, and Qwen-14B for instruction-following. Also asks about quantized lower-cost variants (8-bit, 4-bit) and expected quality delta for productized chat.

- Cost sensitivity: rough target ARR/commit is small; interested in minimizing per-token cost while keeping helpfulness high for support-agent scenarios. Looking for guidance on which model gives best cost/quality sweet spot for short conversational turns (avg 80-120 tokens per response).

- Latency/throughput: soft SLOs are ~<200ms tail for single-turn replies, ~20 req/s steady during peak (marketing promotions). Curious about Redwood's batching behavior on hosted API and whether automatic batching will increase latency beyond their SLO.

- Context windows: want to use 8k window for session history + KB snippets. Asks about prefix/KV caching to reduce token consumption for repeated KB queries.

- Fall-back & routing: would like a simple cheap fallback model for low-cost responses and automatic upgrade to higher-quality model on escalations. Questions about model variant switching (API ergonomics) and whether Redwood supports auto-fallback policies out of the box.

- Evaluation: They provided 15 representative prompts (attached) — want a quick sample-run with Llama-13B, Mistral-Instruct-7B-v0.2, Qwen-14B-int4 (or equivalent). Ask for side-by-side token/latency/cost numbers so PM can pick.

- Security/compliance: SOC2 required for merchant data; SSO/SAML for admin console; audit logs for moderation. Prefers data residency in US but ok with multi-region hosted.

Quoted from call: "We need something that feels smart enough for merchants but we can't afford high per‑token bills early on. If you can show a clear tradeoff matrix, we can pick a default and scale later."

POC plan suggested by AE: 1) short tethered trial on hosted_api with 5k free tokens top-up, 2) run three model variants on their prompt set, 3) provide a simple cost/latency report + recommended default, 4) if results good, convert to pay-as-you-go.
